confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for prices. No Munnar-specific cappuccino or beer prices turned up. Food anchors come from a Munnar budget guide (dinner about $5-11, coffee about $1, restaurant listings of roughly INR 500-900 per person) and from Kerala and small-city cost-of-living sites (beer about $1.7-3.2, cappuccino about $1.1-1.5, mid-range dinner for two about $9-18). I adjusted these upward for Munnar's tourist pricing. Beer is somewhat uncertain because alcohol is only sold in licensed outlets and hotel bars in Kerala, with high taxes. Cocktail and wine are set from the beer price at roughly 1.7x and 1.5x, because I found no direct data. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, with no search or listing inspection. Munnar prices swing widely with season, and the peak season is roughly Dec-Jan and Apr-May. The FX figure is the RBA 18 Nov 2026 observation reported in search results.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to Kerala hill and tourist towns such as Wayanad and Thekkady. Prices sit above the Kerala small-city average because of tourism demand, and below Kochi-level and Goa-level tourist pricing for drinks and upscale dining.
